name: Explain one visual aid clearly
short_description: Explain one visual aid clearly once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can explain one visual aid clearly in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Explain one visual aid clearly means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Explain one visual aid clearly in a fresh real-life scenario.
